ideas.title: The Proposal Speed Run
ideas.concept: A stat-driven post revealing how long it actually takes to generate, personalize, and send a proposal using Claude + Google Workspace vs. manual creation. Visual: split-screen timer showing 8 minutes automated vs. 2.5 hours manual, with the cost-per-proposal math overlaid.
ideas.hook: Your competitors are sending quotes in under 10 minutes. You're still in Canva. Here's the gap.

ideas.title: When Your N8N Breaks (And Why It Will)
ideas.concept: A brutally honest breakdown of the 3 most common N8N workflow failures Alfie sees—missing error handlers, API rate limits, and disconnected triggers—told as a confessional thread. Each failure gets a 2-sentence fix. Visual: rough sketches of broken workflows with red Xs.
ideas.hook: You built a workflow. Felt amazing. Then Monday morning hit and nothing fired. Sound familiar?

ideas.title: The $4K/Month Inbox Tax
ideas.concept: A case study narrative (disguised names) about a service business losing 4 billable hours weekly to email management. Shows the exact N8N + Claude automation that recaptured it, with GoHighLevel handling the follow-ups. Visual: email chaos photo → clean dashboard screenshot showing filtered/prioritized inbox.
ideas.hook: This founder paid me to fix their inbox. It ended up being worth more than hiring a part-time admin.
